reason: E1 shows that high-temperature short-range ordering and chemical clustering occur in Al-Cr-Co-Fe-Ni, but does not link electron density to enhanced ordering or reduced diffusion. E2 correlates valence electron concentration with phase stability and short-range chemical order, but does not demonstrate that increasing electron density promotes SRO that reduces diffusion or stabilizes boundaries. The key mechanistic links between electron density, SRO, diffusion suppression, and boundary stabilization are unsupported by the cited evidence.

Enhanced local ordering reduces atomic diffusion
